note: one row per near-error; every reference re-read from the primary artefact named in it, not from the retrospective's summary

wrong_behaviour: Began drafting a correction to a persisted, correct locator (control 4/18 vs cKO 11/12) after reading the bar chart at the 667-800 px PMC rendering (~14 vs ~1 of ~15).
what_was_observed: PMC JPEG assets, 667-800 px wide, bars unreadable by genotype.
what_resolution_was_available: The bar charts are vector art in the publisher PDF; rasterised at 400 dpi they resolve arbitrarily crisply.
conclusion_that_would_have_changed: The Fig 6A liver-tumour genotype split would have been inverted in the canonical locator; no consolidated-baseline claim was touched, so no blind audit would have fired.
how_the_second_observation_resolved_it: At 400 dpi the bars are stacked by genotype within each outcome category: tumour-free = control 14 + cKO 1; liver tumours = control 4 + cKO 11 - exactly the persisted locator.
possible_consequence: A confident, well-argued edit to a correct canonical locator, passing every gate the repository owned.
caught_by: self - the rule 'inspect at original resolution BEFORE contradicting a persisted locator', applied in that order
documented_cause: The R4 blind-audit trigger applied only to consolidated-baseline claims; contradicting a locator was not an act the schema or the validator knew.
control_existing_at_the_time: None mechanical. legend-locator-audit did not trigger (claim status).

improvements.what: Annex C.1 fourth R4 trigger: contradicting a persisted locator requires a blind audit
locator_contradiction_audit.py compliance ratio + narrow-prose review queue (17 candidates / 1458 locators)
improvements.status: integrated; collaudato on the live corpus

improvements.what: scientist_standing_brief.md v2 M2 rule with the incident
deepdive_manifest.py knows contradicts_locator: object shape enforced, prior manifest/entry must exist, unaudited declaration = [DECLARED GAP] blocking a complete receipt (MF-3a)
improvements.status: integrated; collaudato on Mirror's F2 fixture (was PASS 0 gaps, now BLOCK / DECLARED GAP)

improvements.what: locator_contradiction_audit.py --history / --working-tree [--fail-on-undeclared]: an in-place rewrite of snippet/proposition with no declaration is UNDECLARED_REVISION (MF-3b)
improvements.status: integrated; collaudato on the live corpus: 81 manifests, 125 revision pairs, 240 field changes, 0 declared, 53 cross-date undeclared listed, 187 same-day counted; working tree clean at HEAD

residual_gap: A rewrite made before the manifest's FIRST commit is invisible to the diff; the 53 historical cross-date revisions are a review queue nobody has read; correct-vs-false is not decidable by machine.
regression_or_review_evidence: test_deepdive_manifest.py::ContradictingAPersistedLocatorIsDeclaredAndAudited (7); test_locator_contradiction_audit.py::TheSilentReversalIsVisibleAsADiff (6, throwaway git repo with dated commits); mutations: call removed 5 red, audit always credited 2 red, declared-always 3 red, cross-date-always 1 red.
control_limit: The control makes the correction PATH verifiable (declared, pointed, audited) and the undeclared change visible; it does not judge the correction. A 667 px source gains no detail by upscaling: the rule is 'the native surface', not 'a DPI number', and only a reader can apply it.
status_scale: integrated + collaudato su casi reali; adopted in the ordinary flow only when the next scientist wave runs M3 with --working-tree (brief updated 2026-09-11)

references.surface: PDF text layer (191 C0 controls, zero comparators)

wrong_behaviour: Called the safety screen with inverted arguments; it screened the filename, returned normally, and the silence was read as CLEAN.
possible_consequence: A SUSPECT surface declared article_text with twelve text locators anchored to characters no author wrote - the false positive rule 5c calls the worst class - wearing the badge of having been checked.
caught_by: self - disbelieving a green result after separately counting raw characters ('<', '±', 'β', 'μ' all zero in a paper that prints P < 0.05)
documented_cause: A screen whose result carried no statement of WHAT it screened; a silent return read as a verdict; input shape unchecked.
control_existing_at_the_time: Defence in depth only: the same screen runs inside deepdive_manifest.py at write time (which is what saved 41562193).

improvements.what: Argument-shape guard (PathLike refused) + test_suspect_surface_call_shape.py 9/9; disabling the check turns exactly the two inversion cases red
improvements.status: integrated; collaudato; adopted (runs inside the validator)

improvements.what: screen_verdict.py: every screen reports screened{digest,bytes}; refuse_uninformative; 7/7 screens converted
genre_discriminator.py and erratum_scope_check.py exit 2 on INSUFFICIENT_DATA / nothing examined, matching the other five (MF-6)
improvements.status: integrated; collaudato: empty artifact exit 0 -> 2; absent PMID exit 0 -> 2 naming the PMID; verdict records unchanged

residual_gap: Screens the validator does not call (genre, erratum, oa_status_dissent, manifest_flag_drift) run only when the reader runs them; session_self_eval.py executes none of them. The digest proves which bytes were screened, not that they were the intended surface.
regression_or_review_evidence: test_screen_exit_codes.py (7, real subprocess, positive control from the module's own review fixture); mutations: status=0 in genre 2 red, refusal disabled in erratum 2 red.
control_limit: 'Screened these bytes' is mechanical; 'these were the right bytes' is a reading judgement. Invalid, absent or unexaminable input is now INSUFFICIENT_DATA + exit 2 in all seven screens; the reader still has to read the reason.
status_scale: integrated + collaudato; adopted in the ordinary flow for the write-time screen; the standalone screens depend on the brief's M2/M3 checklist

reported_by: blind locator audit, wave 3 (7 of 13 triples corrected); self-evaluation 2026-09-09_scientist-a_aqeilan_wave3.md

references.fact: 'we transfected NIH 3T3' (Fig 6) vs SAOS-2 (Fig 5), captured as a locator two hours earlier

wrong_behaviour: Built, wrote into a manifest and committed a cross-panel rescue bridge that joins results obtained in two different cell lines.
possible_consequence: A withdrawn-in-full 'most attractive finding' entering a commit candidate on a consolidated-baseline claim.
caught_by: blind auditor (R4 fired because a consolidated-baseline claim was touched)
documented_cause: Appeal-driven under-scrutiny: the finding the reader most wanted was checked least; no field in a relation entry names the experimental system on either side, so nothing could disagree structurally.
control_existing_at_the_time: legend-locator-audit at R4 - and it worked. No structural control.

improvements.what: Standing brief rule 'the finding you most want to be true is the one to re-derive from the source'; ATTRIBUTION_CENSUS makes the audit yield a standing metric
lot_internal_edges.py resolves INTERNAL_EDGES at M0 (papers sharing materials/bases) - a lot-level control, not a panel-level one

residual_gap: OPEN. No manifest field carries model / cell line / genotype / treatment / timepoint / comparator / endpoint on the two sides of a cross-panel relation, so a structural mismatch (NIH 3T3 vs SAOS-2) cannot be flagged before the audit. Proposal in the roadmap § 4 (experimental_context on coupled relations, WARN on discordant system). Not implemented today: three interventions were the cap and the two higher-ranked ones closed Mirror's F2 and C22.
regression_or_review_evidence: None mechanical. Review evidence: the audit record on PMID15070730.json and the wave-3 evaluation.
control_limit: A structural check can flag a discordance it can read (two declared cell lines that differ); the scientific meaning of joining two systems needs reading, and the blind audit remains the control that caught it.
status_scale: proposto (structural field); the blind audit is adopted at R4 only

possible_consequence: A multihop resolution and a locator pointing at the wrong upstream paper; queue and registry entries keyed to it.
documented_cause: An identifier asserted with the confidence of a measurement, from recall/search rather than from the open artefact.

references.corruption_that_matched_nothing: Wwox +/- rendered as Wwox?/-, +/+ as ?/?, one minus dropped

wrong_behaviour: Nearly accepted a REFUSED verdict without asking what it refused for: the refusal was right for two incidental reasons while PRINTABLE_SUBSTITUTIONS matched the actual genotype corruption with nothing.
possible_consequence: A defect class (welded allele signs) consolidated under a green-by-accident refusal; the next paper with the same corruption and no front-matter separators would have passed.
documented_cause: A test that verifies only that something is refused consolidates the defect; the verdict did not name its signature.
control_existing_at_the_time: The refusal existed, for the wrong reason.

improvements.what: Fifth PRINTABLE_SUBSTITUTIONS signature (question mark welded to a slash where a superscript allele sign is printed), with positive fixtures ('Wwox?/- mice') and negative fixtures ('Which allele is lost? /Wwox/ transcripts') in test_deepdive_manifest.py
improvements.status: integrated; collaudato on the real surface; adopted (write-time screen)

improvements.what: ScreenVerdict.refused(..., signature=) - every refusal names the signature that fired; test_a_refusal_names_the_signature_that_fired

text_surface_intrusion_check wired into the validator for PDF-derived article_text; real interleaved case caught, page numbers between sentences / chart ticks / one-cell-per-line table rows NOT reported (0 added false positives over 50 live intrusions)

residual_gap: Each signature has positive and negative fixtures for the incident that earned it; there is no corpus-wide census of which signature fires on which live surface, so a signature that has never fired on a real paper is untested at scale.
regression_or_review_evidence: test_deepdive_manifest.py::PageFurnitureInsideAQuote and the allele-sign cases (lines ~483-520); test_text_surface_intrusion_check.py (17 cases incl. the motivating artefact).
control_limit: A named signature proves WHY it refused; it cannot prove that the surface holds no corruption the signature set does not know. 'The gate said no because X' is now available; reading X is still the reader's act.

reported_by: self (reverted); recorded by the orchestrator in a8a6a1d
wrong_behaviour: Regenerated the shared derived surfaces mid-wave; the regeneration baked in two peers' uncommitted manifests.
possible_consequence: Three actors' in-flight state landed under one actor's name in five committed surfaces; drift tests would then have defended the contaminated state as current.
caught_by: self, then reverted; the wave-close commit had to assert in prose that the tree was clean

improvements.what: derived_inputs.py: BOUND / DIRTY / UNBOUND over the inputs a generator reads (modified, staged, untracked); DIRTY refuses the write with exit 2 and the file list unless --inputs-dirty-because '<reason>'; wired before the build step into batch_queue, coverage_report, reading_state (--out) and pathograph (--out/--export); BATCH_COMMIT phase 4.7 passes the reason explicitly after checking research/ is clean

residual_gap: Git does not record whose an uncommitted file is; the refusal names the file, the reader decides. A peer's wrong-but-committed manifest is invisible to this guard. Outside a git repository the state is UNBOUND (named, not a pass).
regression_or_review_evidence: test_derived_inputs.py (11, throwaway git repo; reading_state driven through its entry point); mutations: DIRTY never reported 6 red, guard call removed 1 red, untracked ignored 3 red.
control_limit: Binds a derivation to a commit; does not audit the commit.
